A month-end close should prove the numbers—not just print the reports.

The reconciliations and review steps that turn monthly bookkeeping into dependable financial reporting.

A dependable close ties financial statements back to source records and documents material estimates or unresolved items.

Core close sequence

  1. Confirm bank, credit-card and merchant activity is recorded.
  2. Reconcile cash, credit cards, loans and balance-sheet accounts.
  3. Review receivables, payables and unapplied balances.
  4. Reconcile payroll liabilities and payroll-to-GL postings.
  5. Record approved accruals, deferrals and adjustments.
  6. Review unusual balances and large variances.
  7. Issue statements with a documented exceptions list.

Consistent close checklists reduce reliance on memory and make review, delegation and future cleanup easier.
